about: Videos to record as regression fixtures (test/fixtures/README.md). 'calibrated': the heuristics were tuned on it and it needs a fixture first. 'candidate': found by title search, not yet run; check the channel when recording (status 'skip' + a note when it is the wrong channel, has no on-screen names, or reads from chapters). 'look' says what it should add to the set.
